text: Figure 7.6: Execution of a trigger provided by an Application Software Cluster • The trigger source calls the Rte_Trigger API, to raise the trigger. • The Cross Cluster Communication gets notified, via the call of the Rte_ Rips_Trigger Service. • The Cross Cluster Communication in the Application Software Cluster informs the Cross Cluster Communication in the Host Soft- ware Cluster that a trigger was raised. This notification is a Cross Cluster Communication internal interface, which is not standardized. • In the Host Software Cluster , the Cross Cluster Communication raises the trigger in the RTE, via Rte_Trigger API. In case of a configured trigger queue, this would enqueue the trigger. • After the start of the trigger execution on the Host Software Cluster , the according tasks are scheduled (potentially on multiple partitions). This in turn schedules, via Dispatchers, the Application Software Cluster local proxy tasks. • In case of a configured trigger queue, the dequeue operation is executed after the last triggered ExecutableEntitys terminated.
